proposal.hypothesis: Loading each source particle once into block-shared memory and reusing it across target threads may reduce repeated global source loads. The pairwise arithmetic and source iteration order remain unchanged, isolating memory reuse; barriers and bounds checks cover partial tiles and inactive target threads.

retained: Stage source particles cooperatively in a 256-entry static shared-memory tile and reuse each tile across the block's target rows.
Keep inactive target threads in the uniform tile/barrier loop and guard both source loads and output writes for partial blocks.
Preserve source iteration order, force arithmetic, and the input particle mass when forming each output.
